ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause because the Agreement gives us no right to our data back or to migration help when it ends (Section 16.5 even defers Customer Data to a Section 11 that does not exist). The 30-day return clock now runs from expiry or termination rather than from a request, and the format is a standard machine-readable format, matching our standard position of up to six months' assistance at your then-current rates and certified deletion after return.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring up to 6 months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter.
